Principal Design Verification Engineer
Acme Silicon
Location: Austin, TX

About Acme Silicon
We are a fast-paced company offering competitive salary and benefits. Equal opportunity employer.

Responsibilities
- Define the verification architecture and own the UVM environment for a RISC-V CPU subsystem.
- Drive coverage closure and root-cause debug of complex failures.
- Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with design and architecture teams.

Requirements
- 10+ years of experience in pre-silicon design verification.
- Strong SystemVerilog and UVM skills; hands-on constrained random verification and functional coverage.
- Experience with RISC-V processor verification, including CSR and interrupt verification.
- Formal verification experience.
- BS/MS in Electrical Engineering or related field.

Preferred
- JasperGold experience is a plus.
- Python scripting for regression automation.
- Knowledge of PCIe or CXL.
- Must be eligible to work in the United States.
